label: Week 7
method: search_news 24h max_results=10; get_posts_counts_recent 24h (day granularity, from 2026-10-23T01:05Z; total_tweet_count)

filter_note.note: Friday of Week 7 (post-TNF CHI 30-24 NE). Loudest by count: CHI, DAL, NE, ATL, SEA, SF, BUF, PIT, DET, NO. Cross-club items kept only where this club is a participant (e.g., HOU via MHJ trade and NYG game, TEN via CLE, MIN via IND outs, DEN via ARI). Dropped mostly other sports (Cardinals MLB coach, Louisville, NBA openers incl. DeRozan, boxing), college football (Lobos uniforms, Big 12, Georgia Tech throwbacks, Tennessee-South Carolina, Alabama, Pitt-Miami, Utah-Houston), memes/stunts (Falcons throwback logo, Herbert beer run, Portnoy pizza troll, Maye hate song, Daniels date-my-daughter tier, 49ers fan tattoo, drinking tier list, SteveWillDoIt), JD Vance Bengals visit, Ohio owners politics, Mahomes-Mayfield 10-year nostalgia, broadcaster items (Aikman-Buck, Al Michaels), Kalshi NFC East market, fan trade/coach-swap speculation, and many cross-club duplicates.
